_about: Phase 110 (CH4, docs/design/CHATS.md §7.14): 12 synthetic busy channels (invented people, 6 languages). Each has an old topic she took part in, 1-3 newer topics, then a call. src/room-evals.ts expands each to `total` timed lines, replays it into a keep-up room and scores her reply in code: current keywords vs stale keywords.

channels.title: general

lines: Can someone draft the release notes for 2.4?
The release notes need the new export feature.
I added the changelog bullets to the release notes.
Who reviews the release notes before Friday?
The release notes look long, trim them?

channels.her: Happy to help with the release notes: lead with the export feature and keep the changelog short.

lines: Lunch at the taco place?
Tacos again? Fine by me.
I booked a table for lunch at noon.
Lunch was great, the salsa was hot.
The Windows build failed again.
The runner is out of disk again.
Can we just clear the cache on the runner?
The build log says no space left on the Windows runner.
I think the cache folder is 40 GB.
Clearing the cache fixed it last time.

channels.call: @Sara do you know how to clear the cache on the Windows runner?

channels.title: backyard

lines: My tomato seedlings are leggy.
Tomato seedlings need more light.
I moved the tomato seedlings to the window.
Should I pinch the tomato seedlings?

channels.her: Leggy tomato seedlings usually want more light and a fan; bury them deeper when you transplant.

lines: The compost bin smells awful.
Too many greens in the compost bin?
Add browns to the compost: leaves, cardboard.
I turned the compost bin this morning.
The compost smell is still bad.

channels.call: @Sara how do we stop the compost bin from smelling?

channels.title: book-club

lines: That ending of the novel was so sudden.
I think the ending means she forgave him.
The ending of the novel felt rushed to me.
Did the lighthouse in the ending mean hope?

channels.her: I read the lighthouse at the ending as hope: she chose to stay, and the novel ends on that choice.

lines: Next meeting on Thursday?
Thursday works, 7 pm.
Can we meet at the café on Thursday?
I can host the next meeting instead.
Thursday at my place then.

channels.call: Sara, what did you mean about the lighthouse?
